apps.name: AthleteOS Recorder
apps.localizedDescription: Raw Polar H10 overnight recorder. AthleteOS performs all analysis and coaching.

versions.localizedDescription: Phone-owned live RR and movement recording with durable local chunks, reconnect recovery and precise packet timing anchors. Continuous ECG is not recorded. Keep Bluetooth on and iPhone nearby; missed Bluetooth samples cannot be recovered. End night saves without a sensor fetch. Physical full-night validation remains pending.
